name: camayoc_sessions_without_usage
description: verification-and-liveness Q19: sessions carrying NO usage record. These must read as UNKNOWN, never as zero — a missing measurement that aggregates as 0 is wrong in the flattering direction, and three of seven local sessions had none. Returning the sessions themselves is what keeps absence visible instead of summed away.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?session ?label WHERE { ?session a aegis:Session ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?record a aegis:UsageRecord ; aegis:inSession ?session } } ORDER BY ?label
